instruction: Open Chrome's extensions page to review all installed extensions.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome password manager via 3-dot menu > Passwords and autofill > Google Password Manager in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome 3-dot menu, navigate submenus, access internal chrome:// pages, interact with Chrome settings UI.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests Chrome internal page navigation to extensions management, requiring a different menu path than the original password manager task.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://extensions. Evaluator uses is_expected_active_tab_approximate to check active tab URL matches chrome://extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires opening chrome://extensions page. Evaluator correctly verifies the active tab URL matches chrome://extensions.
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the current tab URL from the accessibility tree address bar with empty goto_prefix, which is appropriate for chrome:// URLs.

Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly receives the rules dict directly (type='url', url='chrome://extensions'), accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'], and compares URLs after stripping query params. Handles both string and dict result inputs.
Single-step instruction (navigate to extensions page) is fully covered by the single URL check. No missing verification steps.
No postconfig needed since the URL persists in the active tab after navigation.
